omitted_fields.reason: this harness never signs its own trajectory root. A root the author can recompute and rewrite at will proves nothing about the author, so a signature produced here would be a self-attestation, which is exactly the construction the surrounding contract exists to refuse. What is published instead is a root computed deterministically from recorded bytes, so an external operator this repository does not control has something exact to attest to and any reader can recompute the same value from the same tree
